introHtml: When ordering workwear for children, fit and safety are critical. Kids need durable, comfortable gear that stands up to active use while providing proper protection. Our kids workwear includes hi-vis vests, jackets, and accessories sized for younger wearers. Whether you're outfitting a school safety patrol, a youth construction program, or a family-friendly event, these items offer the same quality as adult versions but with child-specific sizing and adjustments. Decorate with screen printing or embroidery for your logo.
